answer: A 3D mesh of the face is built from a depth sensor and matched at enrollment. A photo is flat, so 311 fakes need 311 real 3D faces, and a mask fails the depth test. The quill test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. The mesh is re-captured with a random pose prompt each epoch. The pigment signal is visible to every grader, and the signal ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
